chapter: New Orleans bands, players and halls
title: Drummers before Cantrell and playing with Buddy Bolden's circle
summary: Interviewers and Foster try to recall the drummer who preceded Cantrell, and a job played with Buddy.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I was thinking for, but, when, when, when, when Joan first come to New Orleans, they tell me, I don't know, but they had another drummer, they called, what was that other drummer name, before Cantrell?
Before Cantrell? Yeah. That's a Chandler before Cantrell?
No, no, no, he lived uptown, he was very, booze head. The D. Chandler.
Eh? The D. Chandler. That's him.
The D. Chandler played with Buddy Boehme, with Frankie Abbey, with Buddy. I played a three, three, three job with Buddy, when Buddy went off.
